integrity: Mathematical proof and exact-rational standalone finite checker; no independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: One-step synchronous neighbor-only DeGroot updates on finite simple connected loopless unweighted undirected graphs with n<=4; no claim on weighted graphs, inertia, directed graphs, later steps, or sustained polarization.
title: The four-vertex path is the unique small unweighted amplifier of global DeGroot disagreement
